evidence.title: GitHub - vaunblu/SimpleKit: Responsive connect wallet and account component built on top of Wagmi and shadcn/ui.

name: SimpleKit
summary: Responsive connect-wallet and account component for React built on Wagmi and shadcn/ui.
description: A copy-paste connect wallet experience for React apps: a responsive modal that combines the shadcn/ui dialog and drawer, a connect wallet button, and a useSimpleKit hook to open it from anywhere. Built on Wagmi, Viem, TanStack Query and WalletConnect, with instructions for the Next.js app router and SSR.
contains: copy-paste components: simplekit, simplekit-modal and web3-provider
combines the shadcn/ui dialog and drawer into one responsive modal (Credenza-style)
built on Wagmi, Viem, TanStack Query and shadcn/ui
exports a connect wallet button and a useSimpleKit hook
needs a WalletConnect projectId from WalletConnect Cloud
Next.js app-router SSR setup with cookie storage
